articles.title: The Harry Potter 11-Film 4K Blu-ray Collection Drops to a New Low Price
articles.summary: The best Labor Day sales have kicked off for 2026 at exactly the same time as Back to Hogwarts celebrations. That means right now is actually a pretty good time to find deals on Harry Potter gifts.
body: This massive 4K movie collection was released back in May of this year for $129.99 and this is the first time we've seen a significant discount on the set. It includes all eight of the Harry Potter movies as well as the three Fantastic Beasts films. This deal is available across multiple retailers, including Amazon, Best Buy, and Gruv.

This Harry Potter movie collection is pretty straightforward. You get 11 4K UHD discs (one for each movie) all wrapped up in a big box. It's not nearly as fancy as the steelbook library case that sold out almost instantly last month, but it will certainly get the job done if you simply want to own all of the films in 4K.

It's worth noting that this collection does not include any special features whatsoever. As one Redditor who bought the set pointed out, the bundle just includes the discs and none of the bonus content. This is true of all Harry Potter collections that have gotten the 4K treatment, however, and you can only find the extra goodies on the Blu-rays.

That means right now is actually a pretty good time to find deals on Harry Potter gifts.

articles.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Proves Unreal 5 Can Be Done Well
articles.summary: I've been playing a lot of The Blood of Dawnwalker over the last week or so, and while the game does successfully stress out my gaming PC, I've been surprised at just how stable it is.
body: Just like with Star Wars Zero Company and Halo: Campaign Evolved, The Blood of Dawnwalker runs on Unreal Engine 5, and has been shockingly free of technical problems. The game doesn't have the same issues with crashing and stuttering that Zero Company has, and scales down a lot better than Halo: Campaign Evolved does, although I would still avoid running it on something like a handheld gaming PC.

I've been primarily playing The Blood of Dawnwalker on an admittedly powerful system with an AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D, 32GB of RAM and an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 – well above its recommended specs. And the game pushes even this system, only delivering around 70–80 fps most of the time at 4K with the Ultra preset and DLSS set to Quality.

While I'd love the frame rate to be even higher, the problem I've had with a lot of Unreal 5 games is the constant stuttering. I still haven't finished the Silent Hill 2 or Metal Gear Solid 3 remakes that came out last year, even though I love those games, primarily because they can become a stuttery mess at times, especially when loading into a new scene. The Blood of Dawnwalker, however, has remained stable at all times.

articles.title: Christopher Judge Physically Prepared to Play Kratos in Live-Action God of War Series, but Backed Down for This Reason
articles.summary: Christopher Judge revealed that he actually started physically preparing to play Kratos in Prime Video’s live-action God of War series before he made himself back down.
body: Speaking on a panel at Fan Expo Canada, Judge said he began working out to get in Spartan shape and started memorizing his lines, admitting that he’d been in talks to take the role in the project’s early days.
"We had talked, and I thought, 'God, what a great legacy to leave for my grandson.' So I started working out. I got bigger,” he began.

“Then, just the reality of it... because I did read! I did read for it. It was so hard for me to memorize my lines, which I never had a problem with. And that was my mind and body starting to tell me, 'You don't want to do this.' I was one of the leads of Stargate at 33 to 44, and then stopped. Now, at 62, to be the lead, I just have no desire to live that way again."

As noted by Collider, Judge previously mentioned the physical toll that such a part would have taken on him. “I didn't want to do it," he said. “I didn't want to, at 62 years old, work 16-to-18-hour days. I didn't want to be dieting constantly; I didn't want to be working out constantly."

articles.title: Releasing Cyberpunk 2077 In Its Poor State “Was For Sure Wrong,” CD Projekt Admits
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red's RPG Cyberpunk 2077 infamously launched in December 2020 in such a poor technical state that Sony took the rare move to remove it from the PlayStation Store. Thousands of people refunded the game.
body: Speaking to The Game Business, Nowakowski said COVID "was a factor" in the game's rough state at launch, because "the team was getting exhausted in a different way." He admitted there were "people outside telling us we should launch," and fans lobbied for this as well. The developers themselves also "wanted to push it out the door" because the ongoing development was "really tiring."
Looking back on it, now with the benefit of hindsight, Nowakowski said, "The decision to launch was for sure wrong, period. There is no denying it."
That being said, Nowakowski said, "There were no magical investors telling us, 'You have to get this out.'" Instead, he said, "It was much more complicated and psychological."

CD Projekt's fiscal years follow the calendar and end on December 31. Cyberpunk 2077 was released on December 10 in 2020, and this timing led people to wonder if the developer put the game out then instead of delaying to 2021 to meet the fiscal deadline. There is, after all, precedent for game developers pushing games out the door in a rough state to hit certain fiscal deadlines.

articles.title: Final Fantasy Meets Zelda in Steam's Best New RPG
articles.summary: Years before the iPhone debuted in 2007, Square Enix began developing Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest games for Japanese mobile phone networks. Games like Before Crisis: Final Fantasy VII were built for Japan's then-advanced flip phones, with gameplay mechanics reliant on hardware like a camera…
body: It took only a few years for touchscreen smartphones to eclipse the popularity and viability of flip phones for video games. RPG franchises like Final Fantasy, Dragon Quest, and Fire Emblem all have wildly popular mobile entries. But one RPG franchise, developed natively for mobile phones, is often overlooked. Over 15 years ago, Zenonia proved that mobile phones could run complete, console-worthy games — without ties to an outside IP.

Developed and published by Gamevil, Zenonia first launched in 2008 for mobile phones in South Korea. It reached the United States’ App Store in 2009 and the Google Play Store in 2010, before getting Nintendo DSi and PlayStation Portable ports. A few years after dropping off several mobile game stores, such as the iPhone App Store, gamers can once again experience Zenonia’s classic RPG gameplay on PC.

articles.title: The Witcher Remake Is Waiting On The Witcher 4 To Continue Development
articles.summary: CD Projekt has revealed that The Witcher Remake from Fool’s Theory is currently on the back burner as the studio works on The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt’s Songs of the Past expansion and awaits some of The Witcher 4's technological innovations.
body: GameSpot has reached out to CD Projekt for comment on the state of The Witcher’s remake and whether issues with those “technology dependencies” required for further development have been resolved. We will update if we get a response.

CD Projekt at large is transitioning from using its proprietary RED Engine for all its games to Unreal Engine. The Witcher 4 will set the standard for what a Witcher game in Unreal Engine looks like, and it appears that The Witcher 1’s remake ( announced in 2022 ) got caught up in that technology shift. Now Fool’s Theory is the primary developer of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt’s upcoming Songs of the Past expansion, which was unveiled at Gamescom.

Previous statements Nowakowski made in conversations with investors support his latest comment. In its Q3 2024 earnings report Q&A, Nowakowski said that “work is progressing” on the remake, but in the Q&A reflecting on the entire 2024 fiscal year, Nowakowski’s tone on the project changed. He explained that the remake’s development had been integrated with The Witcher 4’s.

articles.title: New Avengers: Secret Wars Casting Announcement Sparks Wild Fan Theories
articles.summary: With just a few months to go until Avengers: Doomsday hits movie theaters, casting rumors are ramping up for next year's sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars. Marvel Studios has said very little officially about 2027's Avengers movie, particularly when it comes to casting.
body: Thanks to a new report from Deadline, we finally have some unofficial casting news for Avengers: Secret Wars.

British actor Noah Jupe has reportedly joined the cast of Avengers: Secret Wars, according to Deadline. Jupe's role in the sixth Avengers movie was not revealed, but his character is "expected to play a key part in the story," Deadline said. Jupe is best known for his roles in the A Quiet Place films, where he plays Marcus Abbott, the son of Emily Blunt and John Krasinski's characters. Jupe also appeared in Eternals director Chloé Zhao's Oscar-winning Hamnet (as Hamlet) and in The Night Manager with Tom Hiddleston. Jupe recently co-starred alongside Spider-Man: Brand New Day 's Sadie Sink in the West End production of Romeo & Juliet.

In the absence of official confirmation, fans have speculated on a number of possible roles for Noah Jupe in the MCU. Top of the list seems to be Franklin Richards, son of Reed Richards and Sue Storm, who is a newborn in The Fantastic Four: First Steps. Given that some MCU youngsters — namely T'Challa II from Black Panther: Wakanda Forever — are apparently aging up in the MCU, perhaps Franklin Richards will too.

articles.title: Pokémon is Getting Its Own Official Fitbit for Evolved Sleep Tracking
articles.summary: Pokémon has spent the past decade finding increasingly creative ways to bring its monsters into the real world. Pokémon Go turned your neighborhood into a Pokédex, while Pokémon Pokopia lets players build their own Pokémon paradise.
body: If you've been snoozing with Snorlax, you now have a new way to show off your sleep stats. Google has announced a new Pokémon Sleep edition of the Fitbit Air, a new tracker designed to work directly with Pokémon Sleep and give the wearable a fresh makeover.

The newly announced Pokémon Sleep edition is a themed version of Fitbit Air, Google's tiny sleep and health tracker. The 5.2-gram tracker is designed to be worn around the clock, with an optical heart-rate monitor, accelerometer and gyroscope, SpO2 sensors, and a skin-temperature sensor.
It can store seven days of detailed, minute-by-minute motion data and up to 30 days of daily totals, while its battery lasts for up to seven days.

There isn't any special technical advantage to the Pokémon version, though. It's essentially the same Fitbit Air under the hood, just with a Pokémon Sleep -themed design. But it's an easy way to let everyone know you're serious about your Pokémon without having to say it.

articles.title: Rockstar Games unveils its official GTA Online RP server, mere months before GTA 6
articles.summary: Rockstar Games hasn't said much of anything about GTA 6 's potential multiplayer offerings, but the developer is making strides for GTA Online 's roleplaying community. A watch-only nopixel 5 closed beta is coming next week.
body: More than three years ago, Rockstar bought out the modding team and the tech powering FiveM, a GTA Online RP platform the studio had once tried to bury. Today, the studio revealed the fruits of that partnership: Rockstar's official roleplaying server, nopixel 5.

"Rockstar is finally throwing its weight behind nopixel, a group that has long redefined roleplay via deep immersion and custom map tweaks," Rockstar wrote in its announcement blog. "Starting 8 September, nopixel 5 closed beta kicks off, allowing a handful of invited players to jump in using the studio's own launcher."

Sadly, it sounds like the nopixel 5 closed beta will only be available to select content creators and well-known GTA Online roleplayers, though you can watch along via livestreams next week. Rockstar's promising "familiar faces reprising fan-favorite characters and new personalities beginning their own stories."

A watch-only nopixel 5 closed beta is coming next week.

articles.title: Days After GTA 6's Big Reveal, Rockstar Announces A Major GTA 5 Update
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be around the corner, but don't count out Grand Theft Auto 5 just yet. Rockstar announced Tuesday that GTA 5 will soon receive a roleplay-focused update called nopixel V. It'll transform the base game into a multiplayer experience where fans can tell their own stories.
body: Coming up with your own ideas has always been possible, but nopixel adds bespoke roleplaying options to the mix. Rockstar is promising a reworked character customization system that will help players tell unique stories. The world is also upgraded: better visuals and smarter, more reactive NPCs. nopixel will offer more ways to make money, whether you want to play as a hardened criminal or a law-abiding citizen. The update introduces new areas, like a grand hotel-casino and a revamped version of Cypress Flats.

Those are the new bits, but Rockstar says there's a lot more to come. According to a Rockstar blog post, GTA 5 will eventually receive other improvements, such as a new PC game overlay, more events, and "expanded access" to nopixel.
The post reads, "Every player helps shape the city, and every relationship matters."

The closed beta for nopixel begins on Sept. 8 and will be available straight out of the Rockstar Games Launcher. "GTA Roleplay has never felt more alive, and there has never been a better time to tune in," Rockstar says.
points: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be around the corner, but don't count out Grand Theft Auto 5 just yet.

articles.title: Double Fine will finally make Brutal Legend 2, but only if its new Kickstarter campaign reaches an almost impossible $100m
articles.summary: Almost two decades on from its first heavy-metal-infused open-world game, Double Fine pinky promises it'll finally make Brutal Legend 2… if the developer's new Kickstarter campaign somehow manages to scrape together $100m (about £74m).
body: Double Fine slid out from under Xbox's ownership earlier this summer, after the console maker kickstarted another round of layoffs affecting 3,200 jobs over the course of the next year. Four Xbox first-party studios also changed ownership, with Double Fine managing to regain both its independence and its entire gameography ( Psychonauts, Kiln, and Brutal Legend included).

Now, the famed developer has returned to Kickstarter to raise money for ' Amnesia Fortnight 2026, Indie Reboot ' - a two-week game jam that'll eventually result in a retail-ready game, plus a behind-the-scenes documentary from the 2 Player Productions crew (of PsychOdyssey fame).

Double Fine's Brutal Legend 2 stretch goal is likely the studio holding onto its signature cheeky humor because, not to burst anyone's bubble, raising $100m on Kickstarter is almost impossible. The most successful Kickstarter campaign of all time raised $46m for a 3D printer. In the video gaming world, Shenmue 3 reigns supreme with a $6m haul.

articles.title: PlayStation argues "reasonable consumers" already know they don't actually own their digital games
articles.summary: As PlayStation's plan to scrap the production of game discs inches closer, Sony's lawyers are arguing that "reasonable consumers" already know that they don't own digital games.
body: This comes in the middle of a class action lawsuit filed against Sony by four customers, who stated back in July that the PlayStation Store's disclosures don't do enough to comply with a certain 2025 California law around digital ownership. Companies are required to let customers know loud and clear that they're not owed access to a digital product forever, even if they've already paid for it, and the claimants feel Sony's not being obvious enough about how digital purchases don't mean digital ownership.
As reported by The Game File, Sony's legal team fired back in a filing from August 21. Sony said most "reasonable consumers would not be misled" by the company's disclosures.

The console maker goes one step further in its argument, alleging that anyone who partakes in digital purchases knows they don't truly own whatever it is they're paying for, because how could more than one person own Resident Evil Requiem otherwise?.
points: As PlayStation's plan to scrap the production of game discs inches closer, Sony's lawyers are arguing that "reasonable consumers" already know that they don't own digital games.

videos.title: Crimson Moon - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: Crimson Moon launches today, September 1, 2026, starting at just $19.99.
body: Become a Nephilim and fight to reclaim the fallen city of Gildenarch in Crimson Moon, a gothic high renaissance action RPG where every hunt lets you discover powerful loot, forge unique builds, and take on fearsome bosses - solo or in 2-player online co-op.
